channel.title: Kerem Özdemir, notes and case studies
channel.description: Working notes on carbon accounting, valuation, and the instruments behind them.

item.title: CBAM embedded emissions
item.description: A single embedded emissions figure hides the one thing an abatement decision needs.

item.title: Data provenance
item.description: A figure that carries its source, and keeps carrying it through the arithmetic.

item.title: Reduction pathway
item.description: A reduction target is one number. The path to it is where the carbon actually goes.

item.title: Market sizing
item.description: Two sizings, the gap between them, and what each assumption would have to become.

item.title: Unit conversion
item.description: A converter that names what is missing instead of guessing it.

item.title: Emissions decomposition
item.description: Four causes for one change in emissions, with nothing left over.

item.title: Marginal abatement cost curve
item.description: An abatement cost curve that prints the arithmetic behind every bar.

item.title: Discounted cash flow
item.description: A discounted cash flow where the terminal value is not allowed to hide.

item.title: Determinism does not buy you a forecast
item.description: If every decision is in principle knowable, is the financial future predictable? No, and the reason is structural.

item.title: The agent was never alone: SIMEA
item.description: The agent as a decision subject, embedded in systems that steer it, and what that does to the idea of a preference.
